JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH customer_annual AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS annual_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT ca.Segment, SUM(ca.annual_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_annual ca
    JOIN segment_min sm ON ca.Segment = sm.Segment 
                       AND ca.annual_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ca.Segment
)
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS `SME - LAM`,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS `LAM - KAM`,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS `KAM - SME`
FROM segment_avg

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS premium_percentage
FROM gasstations
WHERE Country = 'SVK';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Description 
FROM products T1 
JOIN transactions_1k T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID 
JOIN customers T3 ON T2.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID 
WHERE T3.Currency = 'euro'

SELECT p.Description, SUM(t.Amount) AS total_sold
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Description
ORDER BY total_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.ProductID = 2 AND t.Amount = 1
ORDER BY t.Price DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.CardID = 667467

SELECT CustomerID, Consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date LIKE '%201208%'
  AND CustomerID IN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE ProductID = 5
      AND Price / Amount > 29.00
  )

SELECT 
    c.CustomerID,
    AVG(t.Price / t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
    c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency;
